summary: Major-version upgrade removes legacy parser entry points and changes serializer constructors.

breaking_changes.impact: Call sites must migrate to JsonParserBuilder before code changes can compile.
breaking_changes.guidance: Replace direct parse calls with builder.create().parse(...)

breaking_changes.impact: Serializer construction now requires a SerializationConfig object.
breaking_changes.guidance: Introduce a config factory and update dependency injection wiring.
